# DSSSB PYQ Online - Practice & Mock Tests

DSSSB PYQ Online is a comprehensive, free platform dedicated to helping aspirants prepare for DSSSB exams (including PGT, TGT, PRT, and other posts). It offers over 35,000 previous year questions and mock tests.

## Key Resources
- [DSSSB PYQ Online Home](https://dsssbpyq.online/) - Start practice and attempt full length exams.
- [Sitemap](https://dsssbpyq.online/sitemap.xml) - Complete map of all mock tests and topics.
- [Telegram Channel](https://t.me/+k4QlJ1RnZl9lNWY9) - Join for direct updates, study material, and community support.
- [Privacy Policy](https://dsssbpyq.online/privacy.html) - Read our privacy guidelines.
- [Terms & Conditions](https://dsssbpyq.online/terms.html) - Our terms of service.
